candidates.sentence: We must first secure our border as we attempt real immigration reforms that will impact our nation for decades to come.

And I will make sure our border patrol, detention centers, and law enforcement officers along and near the border have the resources they need to fight the scourge of illegal immigration that brings drugs, terrorists, and criminals into our country on a daily basis.
I will be a leader in Washington fighting for smaller government, less taxes, and our national sovereignty.
President Trump’s tax cuts and economic policies have driven this success – and I will join in the fight and support our President as we continue to grow our economy.
That is why I will always vote to protect and preserve our Second Amendment rights.
It’s Simple — A Secure Border Means a More Secure Nation
I fully support President Trump’s plan to build a wall and make our nation more secure.
I believe that we need a return to the free-market where companies compete for your business, while ensuring that pre-existing conditions are not a deterrent to obtaining quality insurance and care.
